purpose: Canonical cross-chat history of Yggdrasil app builds, published artifacts, download evidence, installation attempts, failures, and resolutions.

evidence_vocabulary.built: Build output exists and its identity/checksum is recorded.
evidence_vocabulary.published: Artifact was uploaded or made available at a recorded location.
evidence_vocabulary.download_offered: A download link was given; user download is not established.
evidence_vocabulary.user_reported_downloaded: User says the artifact was downloaded; no independent download receipt or file inspection.
evidence_vocabulary.verified_downloaded: Artifact bytes were obtained and checksum-verified in a recorded environment.
evidence_vocabulary.device_verified_installed: Device-side report confirms package identity/version at a recorded time.
evidence_vocabulary.unresolved: Attempt or failure is recorded, but cause or resolution is not verified.

operating_rules: Maintain one stable artifact_id per exact build artifact; never conflate two builds of the same app.
Record app_id, package_id, version, source branch/commit, workflow run, artifact ID/name/link, expiry, archive SHA-256, APK SHA-256, and signer fingerprint separately when known.
Track publication, link offered, user-reported download, checksum-verified download, install attempt, and device-verified installation as distinct states.
Associate every installation incident with an exact artifact_id when evidence permits; otherwise retain null and list candidates without selecting one.
Capture exact Android error text, device, observed time, previous attempts, suspected causes, confirmed cause, and resolution.
Never infer a download from a link being offered, or installation from a download/build.
Never infer a cause from generic wording; preserve competing explanations and unknowns.
Before asking the user which app, consult this ledger and the App Registry. Ask one narrow question only when multiple candidates remain.
No automatic uninstall, replacement, update, data clearing, registry mutation, or signing-identity change.
Keep this ledger in the repository as canonical project state; each chat should read/update it through reviewed commits.

incidents.safe_next_step: Use the scoped dashboard inventory and signer report before considering any replacement. Do not uninstall or clear data.
Ask which APK/app was attempted and request exact Android wording. Dashboard is a sequence-based candidate only, not a verified identification.

integrity_note: This ledger is a project record, not a live download manager. It cannot observe Android Downloads or installation attempts unless the user reports them or a consented device report/bridge supplies evidence.
